M180 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.B. REGISTRY
Pootoo Road D. 6871
Jan. 4/1/41.

Further
Labour agitators to operate among workers of Union Brewery,
(British), 130 Ichang Road.
D.S.I.
A.G. Tilton.
Officer i/c.

Sir,

Information has been received that some 20
agents in the employ of the Western Branch Labour
Union will visit the Pootoo Road district on Robison
Road, Gordon Road and Ichang Road between 6 a.m. to
7 a.m. and 5 p.m. to 6 p.m. between Jan. 5 and 7, 1941.
These agents will carry small knives and will
mingle with the brewery workers and intimidate them
to enrol in the Labour Union.

Uniform duties have been warned and all
available detectives will be on patrol.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH）

A.G. Tilton
D.S.I.

D.D.O. "B" Division.

Copy to Spl. Br.
& Miss Hinder.

（印：INDEXED BY (S.B.) REGISTRY DATE 7/1/41）

1941年1月4日。

续报
劳工煽动者将在联合啤酒厂（英资），宜昌路130号的工人中活动。
副督察长
A.G. Tilton。
主管警官。

先生：

接获情报称，西部工会分会雇用的约20名代理人将于1941年1月5日至7日期间，在上午6时至7时及下午5时至6时之间，前往罗宾森路、戈登路及宜昌路的普陀路地区活动。这些代理人将携带小刀，混入啤酒厂工人中间，恐吓他们加入工会。

已警告制服警员注意，所有可用的侦探均将出巡。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科）

A.G. Tilton
副督察长

Dated 21, 1941.

Further
Labour agitators to operate among workers of the Union
Brewery, 130 Ichang Road.

D.S.I. ...G. Tilton.                                          Inspt. i/c.

Sir,

At 4.30 p.m. 10.1.41, some 10 dismissed coolies
of the Union Brewery, 130 Ichang Road, accompanied by
several members of the Western Branch, Labour Union,
collected from a small number of workers of the above
brewery $5.00 each as membership fee, and announced
the following suggestions.

(1) That a union office be established at Zau Ka
Doo, O.O.L.

(2) That dismissed coolies be supported with
financial assistance.

(3) That the reinstatement of the 80 dismissed
coolies to be requested by four representatives
selected among the workers.

D.S.I. A.R. Silva

D.D.O. "B"
Copies to Miss Hinder
and Spl. Br.

（印：INDEXED BY (S.B.) REGISTRY DATE 12/1 41）

续报
劳工煽动者将在联合啤酒厂，宜昌路130号的工人中活动。

副督察长 ...G. Tilton。                                          主管督察员。

先生：

1941年1月10日下午4时30分，宜昌路130号联合啤酒厂的约10名被解雇苦力，在西部工会分会几名成员的陪同下，向上述啤酒厂的少数工人每人收取了5.00美元作为会费，并宣布了以下建议。

(1) 在曹家渡，外侨居留地（O.O.L.）设立工会办事处。

(2) 为被解雇的苦力提供经济援助。

(3) 由工人中选出的四名代表要求恢复80名被解雇苦力的工作。

副督察长 A.R. Silva

“B”分区副总监
抄送 Hinder 小姐
及特务科。

pages.en:
A.J. Magyar
Hungarian xxxxxxxxxx made by himself,
U.E. Brewery, 5/2/41,

At 8.15 a.m. 5/2/41 all workmen from the bottle filling
department ran down to the yard and a number of the strike
leaders began to intimidate all those who were working in
the workshop, engine room and boiler room, and shouted their
commands to cease work, without entering however and only from
the outside. I told our men in the above departments to
disregard their wishes and to continue to work. The first
excitement soon quietened down and those wishing to strike began
to assemble in the yard. Seeing that no others wished to join
them, the whole mob set out once again to intimidate the others.
A few went into the brew house and beer cellar and the rest of
them set out for the engine room. It was the main body of the
mob and several men were shouting at the top of their voices to
go to the engine room. I was standing till then at the entrance
of the workshop, and knowing that Mr. Moe was at that moment in
the engine room and unaware of the approach of this mob, I ran
up to him among the workers numbering some 70 odd. As all the
men looked only ahead of them, no one noticed me till I was
running among them passing all by running up the stairway to
the platform.

They were all very excited and highly spirited and all the
time the shouts were "Ta, Ta, Ta". At this moment I was
surrounded by the mob and as I wanted to go in to the Engine Room
several men reached out to hold me fast and as Mr. Moe approached
the engine room door again the shouts were high, 'Ta,Ta.' Some
one snatched off my cap and tried to pinion my hand. I swirled
round using my elbows and began to hit those in the front of me
pages.zh:
A.J. Magyar
匈牙利人 xxxxxxxxxx 自述，
友啤啤酒厂，1941年2月5日，

1941年2月5日上午8时15分，装瓶部门的所有工人都跑到了院子里，一些罢工领导人开始恐吓车间、引擎室和锅炉室里正在工作的所有人，并从外面高声命令他们停止工作，但并未进入室内。我告诉上述部门的员工无视他们的要求，继续工作。最初的骚动很快平息下来，那些希望罢工的人开始在院子里聚集。看到没有其他人愿意加入他们，这群人再次出发去恐吓其他人。几个人进入了酿造间和啤酒窖，其余的人则前往引擎室。这是人群的主力，有几个人大声喊叫着要去引擎室。在此之前，我一直站在车间入口处，知道 Moe 先生当时正在引擎室里，且不知道这群人的逼近，我便穿过大约70多名工人向他跑去。由于所有人都只盯着前方，直到我跑上楼梯到达平台时，才有人注意到我。

他们都非常激动，情绪高涨，一直高喊“打，打，打”。此时我被人群包围，当我想进入引擎室时，几个人伸手紧紧抓住我，当 Moe 先生再次靠近引擎室门时，喊声更高，“打，打。”有人扯掉我的帽子，并试图束缚我的手。我旋转身体，用手肘抵挡，并开始用左右拳头击打面前的人

pages.en:
A.J. Magyer (Sheet 2)

with my right and left fists hitting at least five in quick
succession. The others seeing that it hurt, stampeded and
cleared the stairway, thanks also to Mr. Moe's timely
intervention who chased away those who went around of me to
knock me down from behind.
All this happened between 8.30 and 8.40 a.m. and at 11.20
I was summoned to the Cootoo Road Police Station. I went there
at 11.30 a.m. and there I positively identified two of the lead-
ers who attempted to force entry into the engine room to wreck
the cooling plant and to beat me and Mr. Moe so that none of
us could work the machinery during their strike.
(Sd) A.J. Magyer.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 6/7/41）
pages.zh:
A.J. Magyer（第2页）

迅速连续击打了至少五人。其他人看到这会带来疼痛，便惊慌逃散，清出了楼梯，这也多亏了 Moe 先生的及时干预，他驱散了那些绕到我身后企图将我击倒的人。
这一切发生在上午8时30分至8时40分之间，上午11时20分我被传唤至戈登路警察局。我于上午11时30分到达那里，并在那里明确指认了两名试图强行进入引擎室以破坏冷却设备、并殴打我和 Moe 先生以便在我们罢工期间无人能操作机器的领导人。
（签名）A.J. Magyer。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科 1941年7月6日）

pages.en:
Wang Kyung Sung
Anhwei,
Pootoo Rd.Stn., 5/2/41 translated xxxxxx Clerk Kao Chien.

My name is Wang Kyung Sung, age 27, native of Anhwei. I am married and I am employed as a workman at the Bottling Department, U.B. Brewery, 130 Ichang Road.
At 8.15 a.m. 5/2/41, I saw Chinese workmen leaving their work as a protest against the employ of new Russian workers, and I also left my department. I was walking behind Wong Hoong Sung. We intended to return home. Whilst passing the courtyard, Wong Hoong Sung was assaulted by a Russian employee named Magyer of the Fitter's Department. I went up, intending to mediate the trouble, I was also assaulted on my face by the Russian with his fist.
This is a true statement.
(Sd) Wang Kyung Sung.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH）
pages.zh:
Wang Kyung Sung
安徽，
普陀路站，1941年2月5日 翻译 xxxxxx 职员 Kao Chien。

我叫 Wang Kyung Sung，27岁，安徽人。我已婚，受雇于宜昌路130号联合啤酒厂装瓶部担任工人。
1941年2月5日上午8时15分，我看到中国工人因抗议雇用新俄罗斯工人而停工，我也离开了我的部门。我走在 Wong Hoong Sung 后面。我们打算回家。经过院子时，Wong Hoong Sung 遭到装配部一名名叫 Magyer 的俄罗斯雇员袭击。我上前试图调解纠纷，也被该俄罗斯人用拳头击打面部。
以上陈述属实。
（签名）Wang Kyung Sung。
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科）
